measurement: Bytes delivered to readline for a 4 MiB unfinished frame. Baseline observed the original direct input stream before this edit; after-change observed the owned framing stream. Caller-allocated chunks and input-side buffering are excluded. No RSS or heap measurement.
complexity: Per-frame line assembly is bounded by the frame budget; processing remains linear in received bytes. This is not a bound on caller-owned buffers or on a queue of multiple valid frames.
